narrative.overview: The page states the answer in one sentence and then shows every line of the working. It is flat and square: thin 1px cool lines, no radii on containers, no shadows, no badge or starburst, and a faint paper grain over a sky-blue ground. Condensed all-caps Archivo carries the headline and section titles. Color is a code, not decoration: teal always means EV, brick peach always means gas.
keyCharacteristics: Answer first; working shown below it in the same flat vocabulary.
Square corners on every container; 1px lines in place of heavy outlines.
Two fills carry meaning (teal EV, peach gas), each always with white text.
Condensed caps display type; tabular numerals for money.
Light and dark schemes that follow the system setting.

rules.name: The Two-Fill Rule
rules.body: Teal means EV and peach means gas, on every surface, in both schemes. No third saturated fill exists; do not introduce one for emphasis.

rules.name: The White-On-Color Rule
rules.body: Every colored fill carries white text. Never place dark text on teal, peach or night. If a fill fails contrast, darken the fill, not the text.

rules.name: The Signed-Number Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only on positive and negative dollar values in the breakdown table, never as decoration or as brand color.

rules.name: The Condensed-Caps-For-Headings Rule
rules.body: Headings and legends use the display treatment; body, labels and numbers never do. Money always uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and a 1px line, never by a shadow or a thick outline.

rules.name: The Square-Container Rule
rules.body: No radius on any container or control box. Native radio and checkbox glyphs are the only rounded shapes.

dos: Do put the answer sentence first and show the working directly beneath it.
Do use teal for EV and peach for gas everywhere, with white text on both.
Do keep every container square and every line 1px.
Do use the display treatment (caps, 68% stretch, 800) for headings and legends only.
Do use tabular numerals for all money and counts.
Do keep personality to help text and empty states; keep labels and headings literal.
Do darken a failing fill rather than switching its text to dark.
donts: Don't add a hero stat tile, rounded card, badge, starburst, pill or shadow.
Don't use thick black outlines to separate blocks.
Don't put dark text on teal, peach or night.
Don't use green or red outside signed values in the table.
Don't add a third saturated fill.
